title: Umami Chinese Prosciutto Noodles
description: A savory and pillowy Chinese dish featuring prosciutto and dashi extract, perfect for a midnight craving. This halal-friendly recipe is a twist on traditional Chaozhou cuisine.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the noodles according to the package instructions.
In a small bowl, whisk together the dashi extract and soy sauce.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat and cook the prosciutto until crispy.
Remove the prosciutto from the skillet and set aside, leaving the grease behind.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the skillet and cook until fragrant.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and toss to combine with the garlic and ginger.
Pour the dashi extract mixture over the noodles and toss to coat.
Return the prosciutto to the skillet and toss to combine with the noodles.
Transfer the noodles to a serving platter and garnish with chopped scallions.
